solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Bond unloaded rifle after head shot

indicators.note: after says the rifle piece comes second, following the head piece
shot in the sense of ruined or wrecked, so the letters of head are scrambled
a rifle with its load (contents) emptied keeps only its outside letters

explanation.surface: A spy with an empty gun, after someone was shot in the head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond' is James Bond in the surface but the definition as a verb. 'shot' turns HEAD into ADHE; 'unloaded' leaves RE from rifle.
explanation.definitionFit: To bond is to stick fast, a direct verb synonym for clinging to a surface.

clue.text: Snort over a crisis

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over (above) the second

parts.note: a snort is a quick drink of spirits, a dram

explanation.surface: Someone snorts in derision over an emergency.
explanation.definitionFit: A drama is an exciting or troubling event, loosely a crisis or fuss.

clue.text: Promoting two-thirds of team, American can start to gloat

indicators.note: only four of the six letters of the team word are kept, dropping the final pair

parts.note: a football or cricket side is an eleven
a can is a tin

indicators.note: the start of gloat is its first letter

explanation.surface: A manager promotes most of a squad, and an American can start crowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevating someone means raising them in rank, the same as promoting them.

clue.text: Student left out breadmaker

indicators.note: out tells us the left letter is removed

parts.note: a learner is a student

explanation.surface: A trainee baker gets left out of making the bread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' drops L from LEARNER. 'bread' is slang for money, so a breadmaker makes money.
explanation.definitionFit: Bread is slang for money, so someone who makes it is a wage-earner.

clue.text: Body parts getting cut, in short supply

indicators.note: in puts the cut word inside the rearranged letters
read as supple-ly, flexibly, so the letters of short are bent into a new order

parts.note: to cut is to axe

explanation.surface: Body parts are being cut, because they are in short supply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supply' looks like the noun but is the adverb from supple, the anagram signal for 'short', giving THORS.
explanation.definitionFit: The thorax is the chest section of a body, so the plural names body parts.

clue.text: Crude tweets bother chap scrapping Conservative government?

indicators.note: crude means rough and unrefined, so the letters are reworked
scrapping says a letter is thrown out of the mixed pool

explanation.surface: Rude tweets annoy a politician who wants to get rid of the Tory administration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crude' mixes TWEETS BOTHER CHAP and 'scrapping' removes the C from that pool before the letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the authorities in charge, and the question mark flags that as a loose description of a government.

clue.text: Astonished writer they've essentially included in dictionary

indicators.note: included in places the writer and the middle letters inside the dictionary

parts.note: OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
a pen is a writer

indicators.note: the essence of the word is its central letters

explanation.surface: An author is amazed to find their work listed in the dictionary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially' takes the central pair of letters of they've, and 'included in' puts the writer plus that pair inside the dictionary.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with eyes wide open is staring in amazement, hence astonished.

clue.text: Shock a friend keeping quiet

indicators.note: keeping means holding something within, so the quiet letter goes inside

parts.note: a pal is a friend
P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: A friend who keeps quiet causes a shock.
explanation.definitionFit: To appal someone is to horrify or dismay them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Destroy extremist expelling Liberal during Parisian summer

indicators.note: during places the shortened word inside the French summer

parts.note: ete is French for summer

indicators.note: expelling means throwing out, so the Liberal letter is dropped

parts.note: a radical is an extremist

explanation.surface: An extremist is thrown out of the party during a Paris summer, in a plot to destroy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expelling' drops the Liberal letter from the extremist, and 'during' places what is left inside the French summer.
explanation.definitionFit: To eradicate is to wipe out completely, so it is a synonym for destroy.

clue.text: We faze 66.67 per cent of Greeks suffering austerity measure …

indicators.note: suffering suggests being in distress, signalling the letters are disordered
two-thirds of the six letters, the first four

explanation.surface: We are thrown by most of the Greeks suffering under austerity.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface alludes to the 2015 Greek debt crisis. The percentage takes GREE from Greeks.
explanation.definitionFit: Holding pay at its current level is a classic cost-cutting policy under austerity.

clue.text: … criticise adopting Merkel's last scheme

indicators.note: adopting means taking in, so the picked letter goes inside

parts.note: to pan is to criticise harshly

indicators.note: last takes only the final letter of the German leader's name

explanation.surface: A sequel: criticise the plan that Angela Merkel finally adopted for Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan and a scheme are both an arranged course of action.

clue.text: Brave man acquires a bar to serve up hot food

indicators.note: acquires means takes on board, so the extra letters go inside

parts.note: a brave man is a hero
to bar is to ban

explanation.surface: A brave man picks up a bar job serving up hot meals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to serve up' only links the wordplay to the definition here.
explanation.definitionFit: A habanero is a fiercely hot chilli pepper, eaten as a spicy food.

clue.text: So this gets chewed? Result: calories

definitions.text: So this gets chewed? Result: calories

indicators.note: chewed means mangled, so the letters of the two are mixed together

parts.note: taken as written, the letters added to the answer to make the pool

explanation.surface: Eat this and you pile on calories.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer and SO, mashed together by 'gets chewed', give the letters of CALORIES; and eating a cream cake really does mean calories.
explanation.definitionFit: A cream-filled choux pastry is a fattening treat, so chewing it brings calories.

clue.text: Drink when sex appeal returns

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: returns means the word for sex appeal goes back the other way

parts.note: it is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: A drink when your charm comes back.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a sparkling Italian wine, so a drink.

clue.text: Slow hiker startled literary bird

indicators.note: being startled jolts things about, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A slow walker is startled by a bird in a book.
explanation.definitionFit: A screech owl, under this older name, appears in Shakespeare and other literature.

clue.text: Final result exposed misgiving

parts.note: an event can mean an outcome or result, as in 'in the event'

indicators.note: exposed means stripped of its cover, so the outer letters go

parts.note: a qualm is a misgiving

explanation.surface: The final result revealed a doubt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exposed' removes the outside letters of QUALM, leaving UAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Eventual describes what finally happens in the end, so it means final.

clue.text: Gloomy cardinal turned up half of beds, then got up

parts.note: a cardinal number such as ten

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means the letters read upwards, reversed
half of the four-letter word, its first two letters

parts.note: rose is the past tense of rise, got up

explanation.surface: A gloomy churchman flips half his beds over, then rises.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cardinal' is a churchman in the surface, a number in the wordplay; 'turned up' makes BE into EB.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenebrose is a rare word for dark or shadowy, from Latin tenebrae, darkness.

clue.text: Plant info gathered by Stalinist politician

indicators.note: gathered by means held within the politician's name

parts.note: Lavrentiy Beria was Stalin's secret police chief
gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: Intelligence on a garden plant gathered by Stalin's henchman.
explanation.definitionFit: Bergenia is a genus of evergreen garden perennials with large leaves.

clue.text: Continue for love from Princess Fiona?

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: love from the ogress means the O is taken away

parts.note: Princess Fiona in the Shrek films turns into an ogress
love is zero in tennis, O

explanation.surface: Carry on for love of Princess Fiona from Shrek?
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' removes O from OGRESS, leaving GRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: To progress is to move forward, the same as carrying on.

clue.text: Call for some Duane Eddy

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A request for some music by guitarist Duane Eddy.
explanation.definitionFit: A call for something is a demand or requirement, as in 'no call for that'.

clue.text: Finished 10 Down?

definitions.meaning: in cricket a side with ten wickets down is dismissed entirely

explanation.surface: Done with ten down.
explanation.walkthrough: '10 Down' looks like a cross-reference to another clue, but it means ten wickets fallen. In cricket the innings ends when ten of eleven batters are out.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means utterly spent, and in cricket describes a batting side whose ten wickets have fallen.

clue.text: Osborne's third budget nearly upset parasite

indicators.note: the third letter of the Chancellor's surname
upset means knocked over, so the letters are mixed
nearly means all but the last letter

explanation.surface: George Osborne's third budget nearly upset a freeloader.
explanation.walkthrough: George Osborne was the UK Chancellor of the Exchequer. 'nearly' leaves BUDGE, which 'upset' turns into EDBUG.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedbug is a blood-sucking insect, a parasite on people.

clue.text: Busy person and gutless fatty like steak

parts.note: a busy bee is a hard-working person

indicators.note: with the insides removed, only the outer letters remain

explanation.surface: A busy cook and a lean, gutless fat man compared to a steak.
explanation.definitionFit: Steak tastes strongly of cattle meat, so 'like steak' means meaty or tasting of it.

clue.text: Very determined, then bell goes off

indicators.note: goes off suggests an explosion, so the letters are scattered

explanation.surface: Someone resolute when the alarm bell rings.
explanation.definitionFit: Being set on something at any cost means being utterly resolved to do it.

clue.text: Charge conductor in fiNER VEssel

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Something that carries current is inside a finer vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Nerve fibres carry electrical impulses around the body, so they conduct charge.

clue.text: Record new salesman's predicted pay

parts.note: OTE is on-target earnings, the pay advertised for sales jobs

explanation.surface: A record of new salesman's expected earnings.
explanation.definitionFit: To note something is to write it down, which is to record it.

clue.text: No traction in hill railway? There's no cause for alarm

indicators.note: in places the towing inside the hill

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill
towing is traction, pulling something along

explanation.surface: A hill railway with no traction is nothing to worry about.
explanation.definitionFit: This reassuring phrase tells someone to relax, as there is no reason to be anxious.

clue.text: Friend to make the last move?

definitions.meaning: in chess, the winning final move is to play checkmate

explanation.surface: A companion making the final play.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as two words, the answer says to play the winning chess move.
explanation.definitionFit: A childhood companion one plays with is a friend, and the split reading is the finishing move in chess.

clue.text: Match socialist in rows

parts.note: a tie is a cup match
red is a common term for a socialist

explanation.surface: A game with left-wingers arguing in rows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rows' suggests arguments, but it means lines of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Arranged in successive layers or ranks, like seats in a theatre.
